title: Run-end marker
description: Written once when a run ends. Definitive endings (run_length, colony_death) are written by the monitor; inconclusive closes (manual_close, monitor_abort) are written by smartrim.runmarker when a run is abandoned mid-run.

created_by.description: smartrim.monitor | smartrim.runmarker | (absent on markers written before 2026-11-06)

inconclusive.description: True = run ended outside the protocol; excluded from evaluation by default. Absent on monitor-written markers (derived from stop_reason).

protocol.description: Fingerprint of the evaluation protocol (storyteller, difficulty, run_days as reported by the game); evaluate compare refuses mismatched definitive markers.
